title: What AI jobs pay in the US, by job title
description: Median posted pay for US AI jobs by title, from 1,038 job ads that state pay: heads of AI at $220K, data scientists at $130K.
dek: Among recent US AI job ads that state pay, heads of AI post the highest median minimum, at $220,600. Data scientists post the lowest, at $130,000.
findings: Research and leadership roles pay most: head or director of AI at a median $220,600, AI research scientist at $196,965, applied scientist at $184,500.
Machine learning engineers post a median $170,600, ahead of forward deployed engineers ($161,359) and AI engineers ($155,300).
Data scientists post the lowest median, $130,000, about $40,000 below machine learning engineers.
These are the minimums of posted pay ranges, so actual offers often run higher.

chart.title: Median posted minimum pay, US AI job ads
chart.subtitle: Ads posted between 21 and 25 Nov 2026 that state yearly pay; number of ads in each row's note

method: From 2,046 recent US AI job ads (reposts removed), we kept the 1,038 that state a yearly minimum between $40,000 and $2 million.
The figure is the median of each ad's posted minimum, the bottom of the stated range.
Groups with fewer than 30 ads (head of AI, applied scientist, AI product manager) are less certain; their ad counts are shown.
Pay is as posted; some states require pay ranges in ads, so ads from those states are over-represented.

sources.name: JobsPipe job index
sources.what: The job ads, with posted pay, employer, title and description, pulled through the treg data service.
